# RNA Generation

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## BiomambaRna

Analyze an RNA sequence with the BiomambaRna workflow.

Exact job name: `BiomambaRna`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sequence` | string | yes | value | Use the exact source field. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sequence": {
      "description": "Use the exact source field.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sequence"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## RNA 3'UTR Generation

Generate 3'UTR sequence variants (GEMORNA model).

Exact job name: `rnagen_3utr`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n_gen` | string | yes | value | Number of UTR variants — pass as a STRING (`"5"`) |
| `utr_length` | string | yes | value | `"short"` / `"medium"` / `"long"` |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "n_gen": {
      "description": "Number of UTR variants — pass as a STRING (`\"5\"`)",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "utr_length": {
      "description": "`\"short\"` / `\"medium\"` / `\"long\"`",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "short",
        "medium",
        "long"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "n_gen",
    "utr_length"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## RNA CDS Generation

Generate coding DNA sequence (CDS) variants for a protein sequence (GEMORNA model). Each CDS encodes the input protein.

Exact job name: `rnagen_cds`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Protein_sequence` | string | yes | value | Amino-acid sequence to back-translate into CDS variants |
| `n_gen` | string | yes | value | Number of CDS variants — pass as a STRING (`"5"`), not an int |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## RNA mRNA Generation

Generate a full mRNA construct — CDS plus 5'UTR and 3'UTR variants — for a protein sequence (GEMORNA model).

Exact job name: `rnagen_cds_mrna-gen`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Protein_sequence` | string | yes | value | Protein amino-acid sequence to encode |
| `n_cds_gen` | string | yes | value | Number of CDS variants — pass as a STRING (`"5"`) |
| `n_5utr_gen` | string | yes | value | Number of 5'UTR variants — pass as a STRING (`"5"`) |
| `n_3utr_gen` | string | yes | value | Number of 3'UTR variants — pass as a STRING (`"3"`) |
| `utr_len` | string | yes | value | `"short"` / `"medium"` / `"long"` |

## siRNA Generation

Generate and rank candidate siRNAs from a target RNA/mRNA FASTA sequence using the OligoFormer generation backend.

Exact job name: `rna_siRNA_gen`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_fasta` | string | yes | file | Uploaded target RNA/mRNA `.fa` or `.fasta`. Raw sequence is not accepted in this field. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

```json
{
  "type": "object",

    "input_fasta"
```
